metadata.title: Controlled Adaptive Assessment Evaluation
metadata.scientific_disclaimer: Controlled algorithmic benchmark evaluating adaptive item selection invariants, difficulty calibration, repeat avoidance, and closed-loop evidence generation. This benchmark measures SOFTWARE CORRECTNESS and ALGORITHMIC SELECTION CONTRACTS under controlled simulated states; it does NOT measure psychometric IRT validity, exam performance gains, or learning gains.

scenarios.name: Difficulty Adaptation Aligns with Student Mastery Level
scenarios.description: A struggling student receives an EASY item, whereas a developing student receives a MEDIUM or HARD item.

scenarios.name: Assessment Engine Accurately Targets Known Weakness
scenarios.description: Student has confirmed deficit on Convolution (score=0.20, confidence=0.85); assessment selector prioritizes Convolution.

scenarios.name: Diagnostic Item Selection for High-Uncertainty Concepts
scenarios.description: Concept with conflicting performance signals (UNCERTAIN) is prioritized for diagnostic assessment.

scenarios.name: Prerequisite Deficit Directs Diagnostic Probing
scenarios.description: Unmastered prerequisite concept is prioritized when diagnosing downstream blockage.

scenarios.name: Authentic Language Selection Respects Preference
scenarios.description: When student requests Telugu ('te'), selector returns item in Telugu with preserved Telugu script.

scenarios.name: Item Exposure History Prevents Immediate Duplication
scenarios.description: Once an item is served to the student, subsequent request selects a different, unexposed item.

scenarios.name: Deterministic Item Selection on Identical State
scenarios.description: Multiple queries on the same student state yield identical item selection and explanation metadata.

scenarios.name: Selected Item Retains Source Document Grounding
scenarios.description: Selected assessment item exposes non-empty source chunk IDs verifying curriculum provenance.

scenarios.name: Strict Independence Across Concurrent Student Sessions
scenarios.description: Exposure history and performance updates for Student A do not alter item selection for Student B.

scenarios.name: Closed-Loop Evidence Integration Updates Knowledge State
scenarios.description: Submitting an answer to the selected item records an EvidenceEvent and triggers dynamic knowledge state update.
